PasswordThe Admin Account is the the account which is treated as the administrator of the Server. Any user logged into this account has full access to the Server and you should not reveal this account's password to others. You should generally leave the account as "admin". Note that if you change this value, the old Admin Account is still active until you delete it.

Update PrivilegesThe account you have selected as your head administrator account does not currently have full admin privileges. Would you like to enable all of this account's privileges so that it can be used as the head admin account?Selecting Cancel will return you to the Select Head Admin Account window. In order to select an account as a head administrator account, you must enable all of the privileges.Account Login: %#s
